summary_en: CyberAgent authorized acquisition of up to 10.0 million shares (1.97% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of ¥12.0 billion through market purchase from November 12, 2026 to January 29, 2027, to enhance capital efficiency amid a target ROE of 20%.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
CyberAgent's Board of Directors has authorized the acquisition of up to 10.0 million shares of the company's common stock, representing 1.97% of issued shares excluding treasury stock, for a maximum aggregate consideration of ¥12.0 billion. The acquisition will be conducted through market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange under a discretionary trading agreement, commencing on November 12, 2026 and continuing until the earlier of January 29, 2027 or the date on which either the share or amount limit is reached.

The company stated that the buyback is intended to support flexible capital policy execution and enhance capital efficiency while targeting a ROE of 20% (excluding special losses and other extraordinary items) from the fiscal year ending September 2027 onwards. As of September 30, 2026, the company held 1,108 treasury shares against total issued shares of 507,132,262 excluding treasury stock. The disclosure notes that acquisition may be partially or wholly suspended depending on investment opportunities and market conditions.
